based_on_schema.memory_brief:

files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/summarization.py, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/ontology.py, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/relations.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_ontology.py
decision: Remove the `based_on` field from the decision schema in both ontology modes.
why: This change addresses a significant issue where its presence caused structured output variations, which were measured and led to weaker base recall in the summarizer's output.
evidence:
- (measurement) "Typed-node fulltext/IDF pollution +0.031 (X2 vs X1, temporal +0.065)."  [commit body]

skip_hub_entities.memory_brief:
### [D1] skip ubiquitous hub entities  (8bc4784, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:91-109, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py:671-685
decision: skip hub entities in the bridge join if they exceed a degree threshold
why: Classical hub-super-node problem in graph retrieval: the two speaker entities are ABOUT-linked from nearly every memory, so they bridge every angle pair and inject generic speaker facts that dilute the discriminative joins a multi-hop answer necessitates.
evidence:
- (measurement) "Live conv-26 measurement: the bridge join fired on 105/105 questions — the two speaker entities bridged every angle pair."  [commit]
supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

### [D2] deferred hub anchors  (4fba7b4, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/context_compose.py:144-149, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:929-940, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_context_compose.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: defer hub anchors instead of dropping them
why: Hub hard-skip cost multi-hop -0.078: in a speaker-centric corpus, the speaker hub IS the join key of most multi-hop chains. Hub anchors are now DEFERRED — discriminative low-degree bridges surface first, and deferred hubs fill any remaining budget.
evidence:
- (review_finding) "covers both the 2-speaker world and multi-entity corpora with one rule"  [commit]
- (measurement) "hard hub skip cost multi-hop -0.078: in a speaker-centric corpus the speaker hub IS the join key of most multi-hop chains"  [commit]
supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

decision: introduce entity-bridge join for multi-hop recall
why: Bridge evidence competes for context first-class and survives tight context budgets, so it enables a JOIN that the traditional breadth mechanisms cannot achieve, which is more effective at establishing multi-hop links.
evidence:
- (measurement) "New Stage 3b (before the generic walk): scored bridges sort ahead of the 0.0 traversal placeholders at the cap."  [commit]
supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

### [D4] additive bridge facts  (4fba7b4, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/context_compose.py:154-160, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_context_compose.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: append bridge facts on top of context cap
why: Scored bridge facts were displacing genuine base hits inside context_top_k (measured: open-domain -0.107). compose_context now keeps the exact historical top-K head-slice for non-bridge revisions and appends up to 2 bridge facts after it — additive evidence, never displacement.
evidence:

supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:382-382, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: The fact-recall leg must run under space-scoped recalls to prevent erroneous firing.

evidence:

files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:119-119, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: Scoped calls now only admit facts from the same project's facts space instead of all available facts.

sibling_reserve_on_top.memory_brief:
### [D1] sibling reserve mechanism  (a762a05, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:383-393, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py:541-601, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/memory_manager.py
decision: sibling reserve rides ON TOP of the cap instead of inside it
why: The old in-cap reserve evicted ALL edge entries whenever base filled, trading the proven edge payload for unproven siblings. Now the reserve siblings are kept as a strict superset of the OFF output, ensuring that the multi-hop signal is preserved in the results.
evidence:
- (measurement) "Measured multi-hop payload (DERIVED_FROM et al.) wasn't crowded out entirely by score-less siblings due to the new positioning of the reserve."  [commit]
supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

### [D2] additive bridge facts  (4fba7b4, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/context_compose.py:154-160, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_context_compose.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: append bridge facts on top of context cap
why: Scored bridge facts were displacing genuine base hits inside context_top_k (measured: open-domain -0.107). compose_context now keeps the exact historical top-K head-slice for non-bridge revisions and appends up to 2 bridge facts after it — additive evidence, never displacement.
evidence:
- (measurement) "measured: open-domain -0.107"  [commit]
supersedes: none / superseded_by: none

### [D3] deferred hub anchors  (4fba7b4, 2026-07-09)
files: python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/context_compose.py:144-149, python/kumiho-memory/kumiho_memory/graph_augmentation.py:929-940, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_context_compose.py, python/kumiho-memory/tests/test_graph_recall_rerank.py
decision: defer hub anchors instead of dropping them
why: Hub hard-skip cost multi-hop -0.078: in a speaker-centric corpus, the speaker hub IS the join key of most multi-hop chains. Hub anchors are now DEFERRED — discriminative low-degree bridges surface first, and deferred hubs fill any remaining budget.
evidence:
- (review_finding) "covers both the 2-speaker world and multi-entity corpora with one rule"  [commit]
- (measurement) "hard hub skip cost multi-hop -0.078: in a speaker-centric corpus the speaker hub IS the join key of most multi-hop chains"  [commit]
